paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Niddah, where he raised a difficulty to R' Abba, according to the Yalkut’s reading; our reading is R' Shemaya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: סוף נדה gives end of Niddah without a daf; no number or independent named-edition verification is supplied.

Yeshayah is the understood subject of raised a difficulty, not an inserted the-text subject. The unspecified Yalkut is not silently identified as Shimoni. Hyman attributes Yeshayah to that reading and reports Shemaya as our reading; older machine סיף/לקום differs from supplied סוף/הילקוט. All three title abbreviations remain R'.
